questions.stem: In a row of 40 students, Raju is 15th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = Total − Position from left + 1 = 40 − 15 + 1 = 26.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a class, Mohan's rank from top is 18 and from bottom is 25. How many students are in the class?
questions.explanation: Total = Rank from top + Rank from bottom − 1 = 18 + 25 − 1 = 42.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a row, A is 10th from left and B is 9th from right. They exchange positions. Now A is 15th from left. How many students are in the row?
questions.explanation: After exchange, A is at B's old position which is 15th from left. So B's old position from left = 15. B was 9th from right = 15th from left. Total = 15 + 9 − 1 = 23.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Riya is 7th from the left and Tiya is 9th from the right in a row of 20. How many students are between Riya and Tiya?
questions.explanation: Tiya's position from left = 20 − 9 + 1 = 12. Students between Riya (7th) and Tiya (12th) = 12 − 7 − 1 = 4.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a queue, Meena is 14th from the front and 18th from the back. How many people are in the queue?
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a class of 40, Sita ranks 8th from top. If she is ranked 3rd from the top among girls, how many boys are in the class who rank above Sita?
questions.explanation: Sita is 8th overall and 3rd among girls. So 7 students above her, 2 of whom are girls (ranks 1 and 2 among girls). Boys above her = 7 − 2 = 5.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A, B, C, D, E are seated in a row. A is to the left of B. C is to the right of D. E is between A and C. B is to the right of E. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: From clues: A...B (A left of B), D...C (D left of C), A...E...C (E between A and C), E...B (B right of E). Combine: A-E-B and A-E-C with D before C. Possible order: D-A-E-B-C or A-D-E-B-C. In either case E is 3rd = middle of 5.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a row of boys, Rohit is 12th from the left. When he shifts 4 places to the right, his position is now the same as Ajay's position which is 8th from the right. How many boys are in the row?
questions.explanation: Rohit's new position = 12 + 4 = 16th from left = 8th from right. Total = 16 + 8 − 1 = 23.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: 6 books P, Q, R, S, T, U are placed on a shelf from left to right. S is 3rd from right. P is 2nd from left. Q is between P and S. T is at the rightmost. U is between S and T. What is R's position?
questions.explanation: 6 positions. T is 6th (rightmost). S is 3rd from right = 4th from left. U is between S and T = 5th. P is 2nd. Q is between P(2nd) and S(4th) = 3rd. R must be 1st.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Ramu's position in a class is 16th from top. He is also 16th from the bottom. If every student's position is unique, how many students are in the class?
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a column of 50 soldiers, Karan is ranked 12th from top. In another column of 40 soldiers, he is ranked 15th from top. What is his combined rank if both columns are merged?
questions.explanation: Without knowing the ranking criterion and relative positions of all soldiers across both groups, the combined rank cannot be determined.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: 5 friends P, Q, R, S, T are sitting in a line. P is not at an extreme end. Q sits 2nd from right. R is adjacent to both P and T. S is at an extreme left. What is Q's rank from left?
questions.explanation: Q is 2nd from right = 4th from left (in a 5-person row). Position = 5−2+1 = 4.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In an exam, Arun is ranked 5th and Varun is ranked 13th. How many students are between them?
questions.explanation: Students between 5th and 13th = 13 − 5 − 1 = 7.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If in a class, Ramesh is ranked 12th from top and 20th from bottom, and 4 students joined above him, what is his new rank from top?
questions.explanation: New rank from top = 12 + 4 = 16th.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a row of 30 people, A is 21st from right. B is 12th from left. How many people are between A and B?
questions.explanation: A from left = 30−21+1 = 10. B from left = 12. If A = 10th and B = 12th, students between = 12−10−1 = 1. Answer = 1 (option B).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Priya is 6th from the top in a class. Pooja is 6 places below Priya. Pooja's rank from the bottom is 10. How many students are in the class?
questions.explanation: Pooja's rank from top = 6 + 6 = 12. Total = 12 + 10 − 1 = 21.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: 7 boxes A, B, C, D, E, F, G are stacked. A is above B. C is between D and B. E is at the top. F is just below G. G is just below A. What is D's position from bottom?
questions.explanation: E is at top (7th). A is below G, G is below A — contradiction. Let me reinterpret: F is just below G (so order G then F below). G is just below A (so order ...A, G, F...). A is above B. C is between D and B. E is at top. Sequence: E(7), ..., A, G, F, ..., B, with C between D and B. Working from E: E=7, then by positions: ...A-G-F... with A above B and C between D and B. One valid sequence: E-A-G-F-D-C-B (7 to 1). D is 3rd from bottom (position 3).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a row, Anil is 30th from left, and Sunil is 25th from right. If they interchange positions, Anil becomes 45th from left. How many persons are in the row?
questions.explanation: After interchange, Anil is at Sunil's old position = 45th from left. So Sunil's old position from left = 45. Sunil was 25th from right = 45th from left. Total = 45 + 25 − 1 = 69.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: How many students failed if 10 students passed and rank of the last passing student is 10th from top and 25th from bottom?
questions.explanation: Total students = 10 + 25 − 1 = 34. Passed = 10 (ranks 1 to 10 from top). Failed = 34 − 10 = 24.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a class of 30 students, A is ranked 8th from top. What is A's rank from bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = 30 − 8 + 1 = 23.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A, B, C, D, E are standing in a queue. B is before D. C is between A and E. E is before B. A is at the end. Who is first in the queue?
questions.explanation: A is at the end (last). C is between A and E. E is before B. B is before D. So from front: ...E...B...D... and C is between A and E (so ...C-A or A-C-... with A at end). Since A is last: order is C-E-B-D-A or similar with C before E. C is first.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a class, Ravi is 18th from last and 22nd from first. How many students are in the class?
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a competition, among 5 players, Arjun finished before Bharat but after Chetan. Dhruv finished before Arjun. Elan finished last. Who finished first?
questions.explanation: Chetan < Arjun, Dhruv < Arjun (both before Arjun). Arjun < Bharat. Elan is last. But we don't know the relative order of Chetan and Dhruv — either could be first.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a class, every student has a unique rank. Reena's rank is 6th from bottom out of 20. How many students are ranked above Reena?
questions.explanation: Reena's rank from top = 20 − 6 + 1 = 15. Students above her = 15 − 1 = 14.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a group photo, 5 people stand in a row. Vinay is standing at the right of Sonu and left of Pratap. Mohan is to the left of Sonu. Kiran is at an extreme end. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order so far: Mohan...Sonu...Vinay...Pratap, and Kiran at an extreme end. With 5 positions: Kiran−Mohan−Sonu−Vinay−Pratap or Mohan−Sonu−Vinay−Pratap−Kiran. In either arrangement, Sonu is in position 2 or 3. If Kiran is at left extreme: Kiran-Mohan-Sonu-Vinay-Pratap → Sonu is in middle (position 3). Sonu is in the middle.
questions.subject: Reasoning
